defensible evidence estimates because their precise locators or underlying sources were not recovered.","The researcher's new manifest labels WEB-021 through WEB-036 as context despite the continuation narrative labeling several as final evidence; this is a reconciliation defect, not a reason to treat gateway or locator-incomplete material as defensible.","Local country-year indicators remain appropriately limited to context and must not be converted into Biden-attributed conduct or outcomes.","No researcher-written scores, score ranges, ranking recommendations, or judge-directed can be handled deterministically after research."],"needs_continuation":true,"reviewer_summary":"Continue the same researcher thread for all eight chapters.
